_what: Numbers measured by watching the system, for the evidence page. Each entry is written from a runbook's observed section, never estimated. cadence_days is how often the drill should be re-run; the page shows when the next one is due and scripts/drills_due.py raises an issue when it slips.

drills.name: A second user joins, is granted, suspended and restored

figures.label: destinations a new member reached while in no group — joining is not being granted
after one grant through one group: the collector's ingest port, nothing else
from suspending the user to their device reaching nothing; restoring took about 2 s

drills.not_tested: a device that is offline when the suspension lands

drills.name: A device joins, changes role, and is revoked

figures.label: destinations a node in the sensor role could reach: the collector's ingest port, nothing else
the same machine after its role was changed in the console — with no edit to the policy
from removing the device to it being off the network, every destination refused

drills.not_tested: posture, and anything the operator's own devices may reach

drills.name: Lost comms, collector side

figures.label: for the network path to come back after a 15 min 9 s outage, with no hands
readings sent during the outage were lost; 0 replayed — nothing is buffered, by design

drills.not_tested: the hub's own link, and a node restart
